decisions.reason: The award-winning yogurt sits close to the core dairy range and costs little to carry, so the option stays open even though it has not appeared on the website since 2018.
The firm presented this cheese as a flagship, and it fits the core cheese range cheaply, so missing website visibility alone does not justify giving up the option.
After four years with only a bare 2018 mention and no later signal of value, the uncertainty has largely resolved against this cheese wheel, and its resources are better used in the core business.
The multi-variant line lets the firm prune weak variants rather than abandon the whole line, so keeping it while trimming is the lower-cost option.
Its sister washed-rind soft cheese was already withdrawn, and there has been no sign of traction since launch, which suggests the soft-cheese option has shown its limited value.
